text:
ashley_cs: Horizon Labs (beta) hit a sudden seat surge after a partner workshop; 8 users show "awaiting invite" and a couple see 429s when requesting tokens. They"re worried about exec demo next week. Can we triage fast?

ben_sre: On it. Org HZN-3001? Is the surge from bulk invites or SCIM?

ashley_cs: Org HZN-3001; they used the self-serve invites UI but bulk-uploaded a CSV right after the workshop.

ben_sre: Running `admin seats list --org HZN-3001 --status pending` now. Hypothesis: rate limiter + duplicate job enqueue.

deploy-bot: deploy 1759998772: hotfix/seat-queue-debounce rolled to prod-canary

ben_sre: Found root: queue worker retried jobs too quickly; dedupe missed duplicate invite IDs. Patch applied to debounce invites by 120s. Requeued pending jobs. Logs: ```
2024-05-10T11:12:03Z seat-queue: detected 12 duplicates, debounced
2024-05-10T11:12:12Z invites: 8 requeued -> delivered
```

horizon_customer: Invites started arriving, thanks. Two users still hit 429 when generating token via CLI though.

ben_sre: 429s came from token-service rate limiting on per-key spikes. Temporary lift applied: `rate-limit override --key org:HZN-3001 --window 60s --limit 500`. ETA 10m to normalize.

nora_enable: I can run a 20m enablement refresh at 2:00pm PT and record. Will cover token-gen, re-invite flow, and include a 3-question pulse.

ashley_cs: @horizon_customer can you confirm 2:00pm PT? We"ll send recording. Also I"ll flag renewal risk and offer a credit if needed.

horizon_customer: 2:00pm PT good. Appreciate the credit offer; will share feedback after session.

sfdc-bot: crm 1759998801: renewal_risk=high flagged for HZN-3001 by ashley_cs; link=https://sf.redwood/opp/12345

nora_enable: Agenda: 1) quick token CLI walkthrough (2m), 2) resend invites + roles (5m), 3) quota & escalation (5m), 4) feedback pulse (3m). Recording will be attached.

ben_sre: Monitoring now: token errors dropping to baseline. Will remove override after 30m.

ashley_cs: Action recap:
- ben_sre: debounce patch live + monitor, remove rate override in 30m
- nora_enable: run 2:00pm PT recorded enablement + feedback pulse
- ashley_cs: send remediation note, credit offer, and paste feedback summary to SFDC

horizon_customer: Recording received and pulse submitted: score 4, comment "fast response; would like clearer invite UX".

ashley_cs: Thanks everyone. I"ll follow up in 48h to confirm retention impact and update SFDC. :raised_hands:
